long_biography.plain_text:
Sordo Madaleno grew up inside the architecture practice founded by his father, Juan. After studying architecture at Universidad Iberoamericana, he joined the family practice and assumed leadership in 1985. The family name, professional network and design tradition provided a substantial platform, but Javier broadened the business beyond a conventional studio.

He combined architecture with property development, overseeing commercial, residential, hospitality and cultural work across Mexico. Antara in Mexico City became a signature example of his approach, joining retail development with public space. As chairman, he now guides a third-generation group while his sons lead major design and development functions, extending the family practice internationally.
